label: vector-store LanceDB backend — fix build errors
summary: Fixed 5 build errors in vector-store: imported LanceDbVectorBackend/Config locally in index.ts (re-exports don't create local bindings), removed unused private fields in lancedb.ts (in-memory stub doesn't need config/db storage), and simplified openLanceDbVectorStore to pass config directly (exactOptionalPropertyTypes mismatch).

changes.kind: added local imports + re-exports for LanceDbVectorBackend/Config

handoff_notes: LanceDbVectorBackend is exported from index.ts as re-export from lancedb.js — importers use `import { LanceDbVectorBackend } from '@adhd/sox-vector-store'`
openLanceDbVectorStore accepts optional `db` property for when a shared SQLite connection is needed alongside LanceDB
The lancedb.ts implementation is an in-memory simulation (no @lancedb/lancedb dep yet). When the real client is added, _config and _db fields must be restored
